paragraphs: Rav Sama and Ravina sat before Rav Ashi; Rav Sama was embarrassed. R. Ashi said, 'One of them is like two of us.' Rashi explains that Ravina was from the Land of Israel (Menaḥot 42a). [Glosses: Sama. Bava Kamma 18a: Rav Samya son of Rav Ashi; Menaḥot 25a: Sima; elsewhere Sama; not corrected.]
